description: Grants, tax credits and subsidies for buying an electric car in one country: each open program's amount, price cap, who pays, end date, official source and the date we checked it; ended programs named. Use it for questions like 'what EV grant is there in Germany'. Without market: every market we track with its summary. detail 'full' adds eligibility and the ended programs' details.

detail.description: summary (default): the short answer. full: every row as well, with source chains and photo credits.

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

market.description: Country code: US, DE, EU, GB, CN. Omit to list the markets.
